iPhones, iPads, Macs und Android-Handys: iPhones, iPads, Macs and Android phones on your network show their screen here – no cloud, no account. One at a time: whoever starts mirroring takes over from the device before.
Aus – iPhones sehen UwUMirror gerade nic: Off – iPhones can't see UwUMirror right now.
Das Gerät ist im selben WLAN wie dieser: The device is on the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
Kontrollzentrum öffnen und auf „Bildschi: Open Control Center and tap “Screen Mirroring”.
iPhones schicken ihren Ton als AAC-ELD,: iPhones send their sound as AAC-ELD, which UwUMirror decodes with the system's FFmpeg.
Installiere FFmpeg als „shared“-Build, a: Install a “shared” build of FFmpeg, most easily in a command prompt with winget install Gyan.FFmpeg.Shared. On Windows on ARM: a “winarm64-shared” build, with its bin folder on your PATH.
Installiere FFmpeg, zum Beispiel mit Hom: Install FFmpeg, for example with Homebrew: brew install ffmpeg
Installiere FFmpeg über deine Paketverwa: Install FFmpeg with your package manager, for example sudo apt install ffmpeg or sudo pacman -S ffmpeg.
Taucht UwUMirror nicht auf? Die Firewall: UwUMirror doesn't show up? The firewall has to allow incoming connections (TCP {port} and mDNS, UDP 5353).
Android-Handys spiegelt UwUMirror über a: UwUMirror mirrors Android phones through adb, Google's tool for developers. It doesn't come with UwUMirror, because Google's own terms apply to it.
Installiere das Paket „adb“ (Debian/Ubun: Install the package “adb” (Debian/Ubuntu) or “android-tools” (Arch) and look again.
Installiere Googles Android Platform-Too: Install Google's Android Platform Tools and look again.

So bereitest du das Handy vor: How to get the phone ready
Einstellungen → Über das Telefon → siebe: Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” seven times. That unlocks the developer options.
Einstellungen → System → Entwickleroptio: Settings → System → Developer options → turn on “Wireless debugging” (Android 11 and newer). Older phones: “USB debugging” and a cable.
Hier auf „Handy koppeln“ und auf dem Han: Click “Pair a phone” here, and “Pair device with QR code” on the phone.
Verbunden! Das Handy steht jetzt in der: Connected! The phone is in the list now.
Gekoppelt! Das Handy taucht gleich in de: Paired! The phone shows up in the list in a moment – no code needed from now on.
Auf dem Handy: Entwickleroptionen → Kabe: On the phone: Developer options → Wireless debugging → turn it on.
Diesen Code scannen. Handy und Computer: Scan this code. Phone and computer have to be on the same Wi-Fi.
Kein Handy hat den Code gescannt. Einfac: No phone scanned the code. Just try again.
Auf dem Handy unter „Kabelloses Debuggin: On the phone, under “Wireless debugging” → “Pair device with pairing code”: there's an address and six digits.
Für Handys, die schon gekoppelt sind (di: For phones that are already paired (the address is at the top of “Wireless debugging”) or listen with adb tcpip.
